title: Entitlement Change Detail
description: User, role, and privilege administration events.
query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI Data Safe Database Audit' and 'Operation' in ('CREATE USER','ALTER USER','DROP USER','GRANT','REVOKE','CREATE ROLE','DROP ROLE','SET ROLE') | fields Time, 'Data Safe Target Name', 'Database User', 'Operation', 'Operation Status', 'Object Name', 'Client Program' | sort -Time
